description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing 'other' extensions in the Opencart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling extensions, interacting with models, views, languages, and autoloaders.

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'other' extensions in the admin area, providing functionality to list, install, and uninstall extensions with associated permissions and dynamic loading.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of extensions by calling getList() and setting the output response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves available extensions, checks installed extensions, loads language data, prepares extension data for view, and returns the rendered extension list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of an extension: verifies permissions, loads models, registers autoloaders, adds paths, and calls optional install controller.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation: verifies permissions, calls uninstall methods, and removes extension from system.
